latest.title: On Liouville problems for $(p,q)$-Laplacian inequalities on Finsler measure spaces
latest.abstract: We study the Liouville property for nonnegative weak solutions of the $(p,q)$-Laplacian elliptic differential inequality $$Δ^{m}_{p}u(x)+Δ^{m}_{q}u(x)+V(x)u^{s}(x)\leq 0$$ and the associated parabolic differential inequality $$\partial_t u(x,t) \geq Δ^{m}_{p}u(x,t)+Δ^{m}_{q}u(x,t)+V(x,t)u^{s}(x,t)$$ on a forward geodesically complete noncompact Finsler measure space $(M,F,m)$ with finite reversibility. Under several sets of integral growth conditions on the positive potential function over certain annular domains, we prove that any nonnegative weak solution vanishes almost everywhere. The proofs of our results are essentially based on the nonlinear capacity method.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 在有限可逆性、向前完备的 Finsler 测度空间上，给出椭圆与抛物型 (p,q)-Laplacian 不等式非负弱解必为零的势函数增长条件。
latest.breakthrough: 把 Liouville 型非存在结论扩展到双指数非线性与非对称度量背景。
latest.limitations: 需核对势函数的具体增长阈值；不能移除完备性和有限可逆性。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.priorityReason: 与 Finsler 分析和非线性势论直接相关，容量技术有复用价值。
